evidence.bg188_streak_rule: previous streak is parsed only from semantic_hash matching eq:<n>; absent marker yields previous_streak=0

root_cause: BG188 owns semantic-equivalence streak calculation but lacks a successor call to BG191 when promotion_candidate becomes true. At the same time BG190 independently writes the same BG186 SHADOW record after live fallback using semantic_hash=live-fallback-v24. That competing write can replace BG188's eq:<n>:EQUIVALENT marker, so a later BG188 run can parse previous_streak as zero. Frequent BG139 polling therefore causes fallback activity that can prevent or delay reaching the 25-equivalence promotion threshold while SHADOW correctly remains non-usable.
correctness_constraints: SHADOW must remain non-usable for normal reads
BG191 must not become periodic polling
one canonical owner must preserve SHADOW equivalence metadata

proposed_fix.writer_ownership: Route BG190 live fallback payload through BG188, or otherwise prevent BG190 from overwriting canonical equivalence metadata.
proposed_fix.successor: After BG188 successfully writes SHADOW, invoke BG191 exactly once when promotion_candidate=true using an idempotent successor path.
